notes.title: Hit horror indie Buckshot Roulette soars on Steam after game changing update
notes.notes:
One thing indie games do so wonderfully is to take a concept and explore it freely. When you're dealing with multi-million dollar titles, risks can be tough to justify but a small team can double down on something with almost wild abandon. That's how we get focused and brilliant games like Balatro, Celeste, Shovel Knight, or even Undertale. Buckshot Roulette is another that doubles down on itself to wonderful effect, and it just got even better thanks to a big update.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Beloved $3 indie horror Buckshot Roulette about to get a free multiplayer mode
This new indie horror game is already rated 96% on Steam, and it's $3

notes.title: Buckshot Roulette — Multiplayer Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, High Rollers[/h2]

No more fooling around, today we’ll be brief.

[b]The long-awaited BUCKSHOT ROULETTE multiplayer will launch on October 31st.[/b]

Featuring:

[list]
[*] [b]New items[/b] for strategic mutual annihilation. No pills included.
[*] [b]Brand new music[/b] to bop to while staring at the barrel
[*] [b]A bunch of new faces[/b] kindly provided to us by Volta Standard Electronics
[*] [b]And the special sting of betrayal from your friends and loved ones[/b]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=5IADjF0jCNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]But wait, there’s one more thing:[/h3]

You might be wondering about all of those ‘beta test sign ups’ we’ve been doing earlier. [b][url=https://discord.gg/crchannel]Join our Discord[/url][/b] to get access to the Beta in the few upcoming days to try out the multiplayer earlier. 
We’re expecting to be able to provide you with access sometime before the official launch.

[i]We’ll also be granting an even earlier access to select content creators, so keep an eye out for previews coming soon.[/i]

We’re so happy to have you back.
Volta Standard Electronics is happy to have you back.

[h3][i]But before we go, a word from the CR Channel Crew:[/i][/h3]

[i] In a lonely station atop a mountain, a train rumbles its precious cargo to places unknown. Now is your shift. Keep the pace. Uncover a mystery. Fight for your last breath. The air is thin up here. 

THRESHOLD, a solo project by Julien Eveillé is coming to Steam in 2024. Stay tuned for more news.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580020/THRESHOLD/

[i]See you again, High Rollers.
May your games never, ever end.

Mike Klubnika, CR Channel & [url=https://voltastandardelectronics.com/][b]Volta Standard Electronics[/b][/url][/i]

notes.title: The Dealer Plushies Pre-order, Steam Community Items. Patch 1.2.1 and more
notes.notes:
Greetings, High Rollers.

Today we just wanted to say ‘thank you’ to everyone who supported [b]BUCKSHOT ROULETTE[/b] over these past few days. We are now [b]officially past the 500k sales mark[/b], and we’re choosing to keep going and Double it! 

Whether you took on The Dealer yourself or watched someone do that on a live stream, we hope you experienced as much joy as we had watching you having fun with new items (and struggling with the new AI). Once again, from the bottom of our hearts, Thank You!

Before we continue with celebratory stuff, let's talk about important matters — [b]patch 1.2.1 is now LIVE![/b] We've [b]fixed a lot in this update, like the permanent on-screen blood in OpenGL, the balance, the controller inputs and also introduced the color-blind mode[/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2835570/view/4168718495686615763][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889921/1fe5864772c3936b02d357e146ce68f4d976fb58.gif[/img][/url]

[b]But we don’t want to leave you empty-handed just yet, so we have a few fun announcements! [/b]

[h2]The Goodies[/h2]

Firstly, [b]starting today, you can pre-order your very own plushie Dealer[/b] (blank and live shells are not included) from our friends at Makeship: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889921/8fd85b1485bf4f3ef804d251d8dc2c7ebf3bd524.png[/img]
[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/buckshot-roulette-dealer-plushie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889921/5b1083f27e42681248e5b728c4d3c8bfc1885b6f.png[/img][/url]

We’re also working on some other Buckshot Roulette merch, and we can share some of the ideas and designs right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889921/a2eeae1cde6e20c2fdce86a912e679a932119790.png[/img]
[b]Sign up via this Google Form to receive updates and notifications about the Buckshot Merch[/b] 
[url=https://forms.gle/XskcVRp8P7GeoYi68][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889921/9d651c0b73d4f2bae688a329f8bdbcbd5c5d6dd5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Trading Cards and Community Items[/h2]
Up next: Steam Trading Cards and community items! We noticed a significant demand for those, so we can officially announce that we’re working on them! [b]Stay tuned for more info later this month[/b].

And finally, a lot of you seemed to like our new key art made by Dr. Jewel (aka [url=http://twitter.com/juerucj]@juerucj on Twitter[/url]), so as a token of our gratitude, we made some sick wallpapers to embellish your PC. Download them and have The Dealer watch you judgingly every time you see your desktop screen. 
[list][*] [url=https://imgur.com/a/ift5SKa]1080p Wallpapers[/url]
[*] [url=https://imgur.com/a/2YaZHzY]2k Wallpapers[/url]
[*] [url=https://imgur.com/a/BYpH4nu]4k Wallpapers[/url]
[/list]
Oh, and just as we were writing this, we’ve reached 10k members in our Discord servers, so we’d love to thank everyone who joined in! And if you’re not at our Discord, please consider joining in — since we’re working on multiplayer implementation, we might open an earlier beta access for them!

See you around, high rollers. The night is still young.
[i]Mike Klubnika & CR Channel[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.2.1
notes.notes:
[h2]v1.2.1 Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added color-blind mode (can be toggled under audio/video settings): White shells are live, dark shells are blank.
[*] Hand saws will no longer be distributed in the first round if the starting health is 2. 
[*] Expired medicine chance changed from 60/40 to 50/50.
[*] Restart button (default R) now has to be held down for a short while in order to restart.
[*] Removed permanent blood splatter when launching game with OpenGL3.
[*] Fixed controller prompts not working properly when launching game with OpenGL3.
[*] Adjusted lighting when launching game with OpenGL3.
[*] Fixed controller inputs not working during the end screen.
[*] Fixed some localization issues.
[*] Credits no longer loop.
[*] Fixed issue where restarting during slow motion slows down the rest of the game.
[*] Patched 'Vellon skip' (rounds being skipped when shooting the dealer with low frame rate and high clicks per second).
[/list]

[b]Special thanks to 1jem and other mod makers for their incredible help with OpenGL rendering pipeline![/b]

notes.title: New Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Looks like it’s our turn to do one of these announcements, so let’s not beat around the bush.

[h3]WE’RE DELAYING BUCKSHOT ROULETTE’S STEAM LAUNCH UNTIL APRIL 4TH[/h3]

This hasn’t been an easy decision for us, but we feel like we had to do it for a few reasons.

Firstly, and most importantly — [b]we just need a little bit more time to polish the new features[/b]. We know that Miyamoto’s quote about rushed games being bad forever isn’t really the case in 2024, but hey, we still think games should at least try to be done before shipping.

Secondly, pushing back the Steam release also makes it possible for [b]Mike to come to PAX East with us to showcase Buckshot Roulette and meet you guys[/b] — all [i]without having to crunch his ass off[/i].
And that’s exactly what we’re trying to achieve here at CR Channel.

We may have some more surprises waiting for you in the near future, and we hope they’ll be worth the wait! 

Until then, stay in touch, High Rollers.
[i]CR Channel & Mike Klubnika[/i]
